{{Quote|A lovely Twi'lek named Inaldra. She just took over as Station Master here, and she seems to be in over her head.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtI" />}}
'''Inaldra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was the head of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|HAH! Some station master she is. Can't even take care of the pirates in the lower level. Look at the chaos around you, my friend.|[[Tarand Crowe/Legends|Tarand Crowe]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:S">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Smuggling|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
Around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Inaldra became the [[Station Master]] of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:TtI" /> The station was home for the [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]], a syndicate ruled by [[Talon Karrde]], but it also offered services to travelers such as [[Starship/Legends|ship]] repairs, catering and entertainment.<ref name="SWG:TPS" /> Although the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometimes had troops visiting the station,<ref name="SWG:DfI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Entertainer|Dancing for Information|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Inaldra was rather sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and provided information to any [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who wanted to contact the Rebellion.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|99|Inaldra}}</ref>

[[File:TansariiPointStation.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]]]
At some point, Inaldra made business with the smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] but something went wrong and Solo bailed out of the deal. The woman lost thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and had her reputation wrecked. She remained very angry against him for a while.<ref name="SWG:TtI" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Inaldra had to deal with an increasing number of problems that seriously threatened Tansarii Point Station. On the lower level of the station, malfunctioning [[Droid/Legends|droids]] has turned violent and attacked people working on this lower level<ref name="SWG:CD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Crazed Droids|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> while a band of criminals working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had taken over one of the cargo bays.<ref name="SWG:KtHB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Kill the Hutt Boss|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> In the meantime, on the upper level of the station, the increasing number of voracious beasts present in the station's atrium had become dangerous for the visitors.<ref name="SWG:TA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Atrium|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> The situation also became complicated in the star system due [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that intensively raided civilian traffic as well as Car'das starships.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escorting|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Moreover, a war erupted between the Car'das and the [[Rak'qua]], a tribe of bellicose [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] living in neighboring [[Station Gamma]].<ref name="SWG:LtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Spy|Lercer the Spy|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

[[File:Inaldra_2.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Inaldra in her office aboard Tansarii Point Station]]
As the problems accumulated, people on the station became very critical towards Inaldra and started to doubt about her capacity to face the situation.<ref name="SWG:A">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Alisia|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref><ref name="SWG:TC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Tarand Crowe|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Fortunately, she could count on several loyal individuals who worked for her, in particular her [[Inaldra's Lieutenant|lieutenant]], the combat [[Instructor/Legends|instructors]] [[Rydel Delan]] and [[Loche Crestingsky]], the [[Security Director (Tansarii Point Station)|security director]], the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Raylen Finn]], and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Training officer/Legends|flight instructors]] [[Serissu]], [[Laetin A'shera]], [[Aleas Rans'ery]] and [[Dartas Pytin]].<ref name="SWG:StILtGW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Inaldra's Lieutenant to Get Work|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

Hence, Inaldra's Lieutenant recruited numerous [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to work for the Tansarii Point's staff and deal with the situation. First, the security director ordered the spacers to get rid of the Hutt criminals<ref name="SWG:RtI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Repel the Invaders!|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> while Inaldra tasked a spacer with killing the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|boss]].<ref name="SWG:KtHB" /> Meanwhile, the spacers working for Loche Crestingsky discovered that the malfunctioning droids on the lower level were hacked and eventually prevented the Black Sun to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the Tansarii Point's main [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]].<ref name="SWG:StS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Stopping the Slicers|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> In the meantime, spacers working for Rydel Delan significantly reduced the population of hostile beasts present in the atrium.<ref name="SWG:TA" /> They also defeated the [[Genesis Red (gang)|Genesis Red]] gangsters and foiled their attempt to sabotage the station.<ref name="SWG:GRC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Genesis Red Crimelord|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Outside Tansarii Point Station, in Station Gamma, the conflict between the Car'das and the Rak'qua caused high casualties. However, [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Antom Moria]] discovered the involvement of a local arms dealer in the outbreak of the conflict and was finally able through negotiation to convince both parties that the war was meaningless.<ref name="SWG:PaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Preventing a War|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> In the meanwhile, the skirmishes with the Black Sun pirates In the Ord Mantell space turned to a violent [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|space battle]]. However, Laetin A'shera, Aleas Rans'ery and Dartas Pytin recruited and trained a number of independent pilots who bolstered Car'das forces and made the difference in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfights]].<ref name="SWG:AtA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Assassinating the Assassin|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref><ref name="SWG:CA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Counter Attack|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Finally, Car'das pilots emerged victorious, removing the Black Sun threat from the Bright Jewel system.<ref name="SWG:DE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Darkveil Eclipse|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

The intervention of the spacers proved crucial to help Inaldra and Tansarii Point Station. Ironically, the most proficient spacer was sent to her by Han Solo who wished to air her with her new position of Station Master.<ref name="SWG:TtI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Inaldra appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Inaldra was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:TtI" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
